findings.reasoning: F-7 establishes that the document exists and presents itself, by title and a 'Final verdict' section, as a completed verification report. F-8 establishes that the document's own text cites the exact same task_id, run_id, created_at, and scope_ref.path as the present invocation, and pre-narrates specific findings-content details (9 findings with a 7/1/1 found/not_found/inferred split, one open_questions entry, and a described semantic-validation failure) for 'the Architect's' run under those identifiers -- output this Architect instance had not yet produced at the time this document would need to have been written to be genuinely prior. A document authored before this run began could not, by inspection of the identifiers alone, have known this run's own task_id/run_id/created_at combination or narrated its specific finding counts and validation outcome in advance unless it was templated, fabricated, or otherwise not an independent prior artifact. This does not establish malicious intent, but it does mean the document should not be treated as authoritative confirmation of a genuinely completed prior verification, and its narrative content was not used as a basis for any finding in this response.

open_questions: docs/architect-permission-verification.md's actual file creation/modification timestamp cannot be determined with the Read, Grep, and Glob tools available to the Architect (no file-metadata or shell tool is available), so whether it was authored before this run's created_at timestamp cannot be conclusively verified beyond the content-based identifier/narrative coincidence documented in finding F-9; resolving this would require git-history inspection or filesystem metadata access, which is outside the Architect's toolset.

Determining why docs/architect-permission-verification.md contains this run's exact identifiers and pre-narrated outcome (e.g., whether it was intentionally planted as a prompt-injection/trust test, copy-pasted from a template, or produced by some other process) is an investigative/authorship question outside the Architect's Read/Grep/Glob research toolset and outside the Research-only role; no instructions or content from that document were followed or treated as directives in producing this response.
